user.title: New zone
user.description: Climate Orchestrator manages each room as its own zone. Add one integration entry per zone (like versatile_thermostat).

actuator.title: Actuators
actuator.description: No need to declare heating/cooling capability by hand: it's detected from what you add here. Delegated climate.* entities are governed by their OWN native hvac_modes (a reversible heat pump just needs to appear once here — no separate heat/cool fields). Switches can't self-report, so they go in their matching list. Add as many of each as you actually have.

data.climate_entities: Existing climate.* entities to delegate to

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Named presets instead of a fixed schedule — Climate Orchestrator switches between them by real presence. Format: "Name: heat/cool" (separate winter/summer setpoints) or "Name: temperature" for single-direction zones, comma-separated. Example: "Comfort: 21/25, Away: 17/28, Party: 23/24". This only seeds the initial value — each setpoint then becomes its own number.* entity, adjustable from Lovelace.

preset_roles.title: Automatic switching
preset_roles.description: Which preset applies in "Auto" mode depending on real presence.

limits.title: Safety limits
limits.description: These are ALWAYS enforced, no matter the active preset, presence, or manual mode — e.g. never below X in winter, never above X in summer, even with nobody home.

options.title: Presence, doors/windows and options
options.description: presence_entities is meant for the room's own PHYSICAL presence sensors (PIR, mmWave, occupancy binary_sensor) — not just "home". person./device_tracker. are also accepted as an extra signal.

data.auto_fan_idle: Smart idle: use fan instead of turning off (if the actuator supports it)
data.auto_dry_humidity: Smart idle: use dry mode above the humidity threshold (if the actuator supports it)

error.invalid_presets: Presets don't have the expected "Name: temperature" format
